extraction.notes: Hand-written fixture for the synthetic two-file paper (main text + supplement). It states the research workflow: statement roles, and the links tests / addresses / prerequisite next to evidence / method. Five candidates cite the supplement (evidence.part). Two candidates pass every literal check and are wrong or unproven all the same, which is what the verification pass is for: r_ko lists a line that is on the page but not in its quote, and m_ko depends on a_map only by order of presentation. h_recruit has no test link because the paper states none.

document.common.source_title: A two-gene module at the qHT3 locus protects chloroplasts under heat in a synthetic rice population

fields.agent.finding_text: Heat stress damages chloroplasts and reduces grain yield in rice.

evidence.quote: Heat stress damages chloroplasts and reduces grain yield in rice.

fields.agent.knowledge_gap: How heat signals are transduced from the plasma membrane to chloroplasts remains unknown.

evidence.quote: How heat signals are transduced from the plasma membrane to chloroplasts remains unknown.

fields.agent.experiment_objective: identify genes underlying natural variation in thermotolerance

evidence.quote: The objective of this study was to identify genes underlying natural variation in thermotolerance.

fields.agent.actual_observation: SL14, showed higher survival than the recurrent parent WY after 12 h of heat treatment

evidence.quote: A chromosome segment substitution line, SL14, showed higher survival than the recurrent parent WY after 12 h of heat treatment (fig. S1).
We backcrossed SL14 to WY to construct a mapping population.
Using 1,614 BC4F3 plants from this population, qHT3 was narrowed to a 36.6 kb interval on chromosome 3 (Table 1).

fields.agent.step_condition: Only recombinant plants that survived the heat treatment

evidence.quote: Only recombinant plants that survived the heat treatment were advanced to the next generation.

Twelve-day-old seedlings were treated at 42 C for 14 h and survival was scored after 7 days of recovery.
Each line was tested in 3 biological replicates of 24 plants.
Survival rates were compared with a two-tailed t test.
Split-luciferase assays were performed in Nicotiana benthamiana leaves.
